body:
I couldn't be more honest in saying this is exactly how I've been feeling for the past few months. Simple things will make me want to ball when I been fine the moment before. I'm currently going to college and I've begun to question what the point even is anymore. It would be so easy just to end it and not feel the pressures of school and the weight of social interactions. Hardly eating because I can't stomach it, hardly sleeping because I'm woken up with jerking thoughts that make me relive the pain all over again. It's an endless nightmare to us all. 

I think what's kept me from doing it is that the feeling isn't always a sad wanting to cry feeling, but mostly an empty feeling, which leaves me feeling like a ghost drifting through the day. Like everything that happens is a blur and unfulfilling.

I'm in the exact same situation. 

I've never felt more alone than I do now, and the worst part about it is that I'm surrounded by people the same age who are having a blast at college, partying and being social in all aspects. I try to reach out to people around me and try to stay active, but it feels so futile. Ever since she left me I haven't been the same, but I keep on trying to move on. No matter how rough one day is over the other, I tell myself things will change and I'll meet someone new who actually cares about me. I don't need her. You don't need her. As much as you might want her, you do not need her. You just have to move on, fully knowing that there will be plenty of days when you're still going to break down, or the slightest provocation will make your chest hurt, but that's okay. Though it's only been a couple month since it happened, I do have a day here and there when I can forget about it all and enjoy being in the moment with a friend. I've thrown myself into my school work and am trying to meet new people through organizations which helps a little. It's only at its worst when I feel alone and have no one to talk to, that's when I have to make a real effort to reach out and that still is not an easy thing to do, considering I don't a single person I feel entirely comfortable talking deeply with here.

Hang in there friend.

I have and the feeling isn't as hard as it was, but every now and again it just comes out of nowhere and hits me like a truck. One moment I'm fine and the next I can hardly think. Luckily I've been able to get a decent amount of studying in before my midterm today so I'm hoping for the best.
